
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/22574172" title="发布于 2026-08-19 16:39">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">k8s 实战5----服务service （svc）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 15px">k8s服务是什么？</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><em><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在了解本块内容之前，你需要对k8s由一个前期的了解包括pod/标签/副本集</span></em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>不了解的同学可以参考前文：</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>k8s 实战 1 ---- 初识 （https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/18245222）</em></span><br><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>k8s 实战 2 ---- pod 基础 (https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/18284282)</em></span><br><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>k8s 实战 3 ---- 标签（https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/18293278 ）</em></span><br><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>k8s 实战 4----副本集 ReplicaSet（RS）https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/18597501</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我们先不要管它的定义，先说个比较实际的问题，假设我们有一堆的微服务，都是用pod或者副本集rs来启动起来的。这些微服务一般来说是呈网状的调用关系。此时如果微服务A想要调用微服务B，可以怎么办呢？</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">最简单的办法就是通过pod 分配的ip，直接请求就OK了，但是这就会有一个问题：<strong>b服务有好几个实例，怎么调用呢？</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">很容易就想到如果用spring cloud的话，直接用服务注册和发现，在配合feign之类的客户端，直接请求。这是一个很好的解决办法，但是它存在两个问题：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">（1）这必须要求所有的服务都有能力进行服务注册发现，并负载均衡的调用下游。一方面是语言的问题，还有一方面是生态的问题，1这些所有的微服务是否都支持这个服务中心，它们是否都有feign之类的客户端，没有的话，是不是要自己复刻能力。这要是纯手写，先不论工作量怎么样，单就代码质量是否可以在短期内完成商用级别都成问题。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">（2）服务无法在逻辑层面统一，比如A服务有实例 a1，a2，a3.此时新开发了一套B服务 B1，B2,B3,假设它们都有发送短信的能力，你现在要随机发送到 A服务的接口中，也可以发送到B服务的接口中，你怎么做呢？原有的方案就很难支持这种动态的随意划分了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">k8s 想到了一个办法：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">每个pod 都有标签，我根据标签进行划分，每划分出来一类集合，我给它们创建一个资源作为请求入口，直接通过访问这个资源就可以轻松到访问到对应微服务的接口。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">而这些微服务完全没必要是相同的镜像实例，它们只要是符合标签的匹配规则即可。(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )这就是服务，换句话说它是一个抽象的pod集合。一个pod可以同时属于多个服务。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">举个例子</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">A 服务实例：a1，a2，a3   标签是app=asvc, message=true, v=va ,company=yidong</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">B 服务实例：b1，b2，b3   标签是app=bsvc, message=true,voice=true, v=vb ,company=liantong</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">C 服务实例：c1，c2，c3   标签是app=csvc, send=voice,voice=true,  v=vc ,company=dianxin</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我创建两个k8s服务资源</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">msg-svc， 标签过滤规则是 message=true</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">voice-svc 标签过滤规则是 voice=true</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样当其它服务需要发送短信时，就向msg-svc 这个服务直接发送请求，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">需要发送语言时，就向voice-svc 这个服务直接发送请求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样你可以通过标签规则，随意的划拨出一个你需要的服务资源的范围。然后外部统一请求这个入口即可。当然前提是你这个范围内的pod在此处功能点上都有统一的api规范。另外你还也完全屏蔽了由于pod ip地址不断变化，导致的无法动态的请求pod的问题，当然原有的spring cloud服务发现机制本来也解决了这个问题。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">以上就是k8s中service资源的介绍，<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>我对它的理解就是通过标签筛选出符合条件的一个容器集合。然后有一个统一的入口，当请求进入入口后，可以通过kube-proxy，将流量转发给具体的pod容器。</strong></span></span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">下边我们来具体说说k8s service的使用：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">k8s是通过使用场景的不同，来划分出不同类型的service的，</span><br><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）clusterIp</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">它是k8s默认的服务类型，也是最常用的服务类型。基本可以解决绝大多数的使用场景。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">定义yaml文件如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  name: msg-svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  namespace: ${ACTIVE_ENV} //看具体情况，可以不填
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  type: ClusterIP //注意此处可以不填，默认就是clusterip类型的服务
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    - port: 9090
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      protocol: TCP
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      targetPort: 9080
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     message: "true"</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">保存好文件之后，比如命名为msgsvc.yaml</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">然后通过  kubectl apply -f msgsvc.yaml 命令 ，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )就可以创建一个对应的服务了。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  cat nginx-clusterIp-svc.yaml
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  name: ng-clusterip-svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  type: ClusterIP
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    - port: 9090
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      protocol: TCP
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      targetPort: 9080
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    message: true
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl apply -f nginx-clusterIp-svc.yaml
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> service/ng-clusterip-svc created</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我们可以用如下命令查询到这个服务：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">kubectl get service&nbsp;</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">NAME                        TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)                               AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> kubernetes                  ClusterIP   10.232.0.1      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">none</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        443/TCP                               234d
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> ng-clusterip-svc            ClusterIP   10.232.22.12    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">none</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>        9090/TCP                              60s</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">注意service 作为一层实实在在的资源，是有映射能力的，因此yaml文件中</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">ports.port 表示的就是service的端口</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">ports.targetPort 表示的就是service映射到pod后，所对应的pod端口</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我们现在有两种请求clusterip service 的办法，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">1 通过服务名称</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">如：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">curl ng-clusterip-svc.命名空间:9090   //同命名空间下可以忽略命名空间</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">2 通过分配的CLUSTER-IP （虚拟ip）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">curl 10.232.22.12:9090</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这两种方式无论是pod内还是pod 外，只要是在集群中，就可以直接请求，满足了大部分的业务调用场景</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）NodePort</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">ClusterIP解决了集群内部请求服务的问题，但是有时候我们需要在集群外部访问这个集群中的某个服务，就需要使用NodePort的方式了。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">创建办法如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  cat  nginx-nodeport-svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  name: ng-nodeport-svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  type: NodePort
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    - port: 9090
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      protocol: TCP
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      targetPort: 9080
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      nodePort: 31010
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    message: "true"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kubectl apply -f nginx-nodeport-svc.yaml  
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> service/ng-nodeport-svc created</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">查询service&nbsp;</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> NAME                        TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP   PORT(S)                               AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> kubernetes                  ClusterIP   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span>      &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TCP                               234d
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> ng-clusterip-svc            ClusterIP   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">33.193</span>   &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9090</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TCP                              4s
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> ng-nodeport-svc             NodePort    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.76</span>     &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9090</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">31010</span>/TCP                        14s</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我们发现ng-nodeport-svc的yaml其实和clusterip 的创建方式非常像，只有两点区别，类型为NodePort ，端口多了一个ports.nodePort ，这个nodeport 的取值范围是30000 ~ 32767。如果不写的话，会随机分配一个没被占用的端口。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">NodePort 的访问方式有两种</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">1 使用clusterIp的方式</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">NodePort底层包含clusterIp，所以可以直接用请求clusterIp的方式来请求nodeport，注意端口填port，并且也仅限在集群内部请求。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">2 通过NodePort端口</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">客户端可以直接通过"k8s集群节点:NodePort"</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">集群节点是集群内的任意节点可以是master也可以是worker Node节点，端口就填yaml中配置的NodePort即可。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">比如集群master节点是 36.1.5.1，那么无论集(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )群内部还是外部都可以通过 curl 36.1.5.1:NodePort 的方式请求成功。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">因此nodePort对于不同服务来说是会互相冲突的，因此创建nodeport服务的数量也是有限的，这是nodeport的一个缺点。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">一般来说其实nodeport的使用情况很少，一方面是调配端口比较麻烦，很容易冲突，另外一方面是不安全不好管理，生产情况下不愿意暴露这么多的端口出去，引起外部的攻击。一般是在测试环境测试接口用。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（3）Load Balancer </span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">nodeport service 通过节点路由，解决了集群外部请求的问题。这样基本够用了。但是实际生产中，我们往往不使用nodeport ，而是使用Load Balancer。它是基于nodeport 的更高一级的封装，通过使用云服务厂商自带的负载均衡器，以及公网地址，允许用户通过调用固定公网地址，直接请求到内部的nodeport上。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样做有几个好处：1，统一入口，公网地址不随意调整，不会随着集群的节点扩缩容而不断的调整客户端的请求配置。2，通过负载均衡器，调整不同的节点压力，同时还无需暴露所有节点的ip 端口，性能和安全性全部拉满。3，ssl卸载，所谓ssl卸载是指https协议的请求，在请求到服务端之后需要解密，而这个过程对于高并发下，是个很耗费性能的点，此时可以通过将ssl卸载的逻辑移植到厂商的负载均衡器上，让进入服务的请求不再解密从而降低服务端的压力。4，会话保持，通过负载均衡器的请求，可以进行七层负载均衡，其中就包括cookie header，这样尽可能的将相同用户的请求打到同一个后端pod或某几个pod上，让用户信息尽可能的隔离(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )，比如vip用户优先渠道，多租户隔离等。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">但这些能力有些需要ingress资源（k8s的又一种资源）配合LoadBalancer 的负载均衡器共同完成。如果是在私有云或者内建集群上，也想要体现LB所带来的能力，也可以自建一些开源的负载均衡器来操作入MetalLB，OpenELB，这就说的太远了，不说了。有兴趣的同学可以自己研究下。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">下边我们来看下实操，创建lb service：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> #  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> nginx-lb-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>   name: ng-lb-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  type: LoadBalancer
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     - port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9090</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      protocol: TCP
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>       targetPort: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9080</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>       nodePort: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">31011</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     message: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">由于上一个例子使用了nodePort端口 31010，因此我们这里使用31011，否则会报端口占用的错误。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> #  kubectl apply -f nginx-lb-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> service/ng-lb-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc created
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> NAME                        TYPE           CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP   PORT(S)                               AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> kubernetes                  ClusterIP      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span>      &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TCP                               238d
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> ng-clusterip-svc            ClusterIP      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">33.193</span>   &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9090</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TCP                              3d21h
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> ng-lb-svc                   LoadBalancer   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.232</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16.65</span>    &lt;pending&gt;     <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9090</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">31011</span>/TCP                        7s</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样就创建好LB service了，但是注意看EXTERNAL-IP列 ，外部ip 显示是&lt;pending&gt;，这是由于我是在自建集群中操作的。k8s拿不到外部的ip，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">假设EXTERNAL-IP 的值是10.12.123.124。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">那么就可通过使用 EXTERNAL-IP:PORT 的方式请求服务，如curl 10.12.123.124:9090</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（4） headless </span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">headless 又被称之为无头服务。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">一般来说服务之间，外部与集群之间，不同集群之间，通过以上3种服务基本就可以满足服务的正常使用了，但是有一种情况却不行，那就是有状态服务。啥是有状态服务呢？简单来说就是服务的多个实例之间（也可以是单个）是有身份区别的，比如mysql 的主从实例 或者服务的内部是有状态差异的，不能每次请求都可以随意请求，比如我在A实例创建订单，将订单状态放到实例内存中，后边更新订单状态时，只能请求到这个订单上。当然后者在微服务场景是不推荐的一种设计。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">来看下如何使用无头服务:</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">先创建无头服务：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> #  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> myapp-headless-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>   name:  myapp-headless-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc          # 服务的名字
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  clusterIP: None      # 关键：不分配虚拟 IP，直接暴露 Pod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    app1: myapp1         # 关联到下面 StatefulSet 的 Pod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     - port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4321</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      name: myapp
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> #  kubectl apply -f myapp-headless-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> service/myapp-headless-svc created</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">然后需要创建状态集，它和副本集很像，区别是它所对应的pod是按照一定顺序来命名和创建的（后边介绍statful时，会详细说）</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> #  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> myapp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">statefulSet.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> apiVersion: apps/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: StatefulSet
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>   name: myapp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sts
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>   serviceName: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myapp-headless-svc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> # 关键：必须与 Headless Service 的名字一致！
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>   replicas: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>          # 创建 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个 Pod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  selector:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    matchLabels:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      app1: myapp1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  template:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      labels:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        app1: myapp1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      containers:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>       -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: mysql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         image: registry.cmjt.com:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8443</span>/ai_znm/llm-response-api-service:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20260805144832</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         - containerPort: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4321</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> #  kubectl apply -f myapp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">statefulSet.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> statefulset.apps/myapp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sts created
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get statefulset
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">NAME        READY   AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> myapp-sts   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">     14m
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get pod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">NAME                                           READY   STATUS             RESTARTS        AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> myapp-sts-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>                                    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>     Running   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (3m52s ago)   15m
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> myapp-sts-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>                                    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>     Running   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (3m52s ago)   15m
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> myapp-sts-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>                                    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>     Running   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span> (3m46s ago)   15m</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">注意看3个pod的名字都是按照statefulset名称加需要标识好的，也就是说pod名称是固定的，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样我们就可以将myapp-sts-0 定为主节点，myapp-sts-1 ，myapp-sts-2 定为从节点。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">然后根据pod 名称访问不同的节点，如：</span></p>
<p><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">当需要访问主节点的时候就</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">curl myapp-sts-0:4321</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">访问从节点时</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">curl myapp-sts-1:4321</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">curl myapp-sts-2:4321</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样我们在集群中，就可以通过主从节点的名称，定义好它们的数据同步策略等类似的场景。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（5）别名服务</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">别名服务其实很简单，就是一层对外部域名的映射。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">如公司有一套 user.com 的员工系统。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">我们直接请求访问就好了，但是后边员工系统升级了，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )为了体现区别，就叫做newuser.com，后边再来一次升级，就叫做2026user.com吧。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">每次升级我们都要改代码，不改代码也可以，还可以使用配置中心，但是配置中心改起来也很麻烦，那么就还可以直接定义一个服务层（别名服务），然后直接请求到对应真实服务就好，我们每次修改只要修改别名服务的转发配置即可。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">就像这样 curl 别名服务名:端口</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">举个例子</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">假设有这样一个服务，在其它的命名空间：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> #  kubectl get service -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n test
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> NAME                             TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP   PORT(S)          AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> llm-api-service-svc              NodePort    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.233</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">44.18</span>    &lt;none&gt;        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9043</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32100</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TCP   65d
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> #  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> myapi-external-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kind: Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metadata:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>   name: myapi-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">spec:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  type: ExternalName
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>   externalName: llm-api-service-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.test.svc.cluster.local # 外部真实的域名
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ports:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     - port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9043</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> #  kubectl apply -f myapi-external-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc.yaml 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> service/myapi-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">svc configured
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#  kubectl get service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> NAME                 TYPE           CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP                           PORT(S)                                                                      AGE
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> myapi-svc            ExternalName   &lt;none&gt;         <strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> llm-api-service-svc.test.svc.cluster.local</span> </strong>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9043</span>/TCP   </span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">然后我们进一个同命名空间下的pod ，发起curl 请求：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> kubectl exec -it nacos-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> -- /bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> /home/nacos # curl myapi-svc:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9043</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> &lt;!doctype html&gt;&lt;html lang=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">en</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">head</span>&gt;&lt;title&gt;HTTP Status <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">404</span> – Not Found&lt;/title&gt;...</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">这样就可以请求通了。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">在此，要注意的是：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">按照标准的 服务名称请求的话，标准的url是：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">服务名称.命名空间.搜索域:端口号</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">命名空间 每个资源所在的空间，默认是default 空间</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">搜索域是   svc.cluster.local</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">一般来说 搜索域可以直接忽略，直接请求：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">服务名称.命名空间:端口号 即可</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">如果请求容器和服务是相同命名空间的话，则命名空间也可以省略直接请求：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">服务名称:端口号 即可。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 13px">刚才的别名服务中的目标服务地址（红色加粗部分），需要写完整的服务地址，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )这是由于别名服务的定义中，如果是目标服务就是本命名空间，则直接写服务名称即可，而如果是跨命名空间，则需要在指定命名空间的同时，还要指定搜索域。否则容器在使用时，会无法解析到目标地址。</span></p>

</div>
